mapper.select: SELECT id, username, COALESCE(NULLIF(nickname,''),username) AS display_name FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 1
SELECT id,username,COALESCE(NULLIF(nickname,''),username) AS display_name FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_member(canvas_id,user_id,can_edit,can_execute,can_manage,granted_by) VALUES (#{canvasId},#{userId},#{canEdit},#{canExecute},#{canManage},#{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE can_edit=VALUES(can_edit),can_execute=VALUES(can_execute), can_manage=VALUES(can_manage),granted_by=VALUES(granted_by),update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT m.canvas_id,m.can_edit,m.can_execute,m.can_manage,m.granted_by FROM afv_canvas_member m JOIN afv_canvas c ON c.id=m.canvas_id WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE m FROM afv_canvas_member m JOIN afv_canvas c ON c.id=m.canvas_id WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.user_id=#{userId}
